title: "Solano County Dashboard Summary"
subtitle: "2024"
author: SCOE Assessment Research and Evaluation
format:
  pptx:
    reference-doc: template.pptx
editor: visual
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(webshot)
library(officer)

# webshot::install_phantomjs()

dashboard <- read_csv("data/solano_dashboard.csv") %>% 
  filter(countyname == "Solano",
         reportingyear == 2024) %>% 
  mutate(color = as_factor(color),
         color = fct_relevel(color, "0","1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
         indicator_color = case_when(
          rtype == "S" & color == 0 ~ "#D3D3D3",
          rtype == "S" & color == 1 ~ "#FF6347",
          rtype == "S" & color == 2 ~ "#FFA500",
          rtype == "S" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFF00",
          rtype == "S" & color == 4 ~ "#3CB371",
          rtype == "S" & color == 5 ~ "#1E90FF",
          rtype == "D" & color == 1 ~ "#CD5C5C",
          rtype == "D" & color == 2 ~ "#FFAF70",
          rtype == "D" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFACD",
          rtype == "D" & color == 4 ~ "#90EE90",
          rtype == "D" & color == 5 ~ "#87CEFA",
                           .default = "#737373"))

district_geo <- read_sf("data/California_School_District_Areas_2022-23.geojson")
school_geo <- read_sf("data/California_Schools_2022-23.geojson")

district_geo <- 
  district_geo %>% 
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") %>% 
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>% 
  rename(cds = cdscode) %>% 
  mutate(center_point =  st_centroid(geometry),
         lng = st_coordinates(center_point)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(center_point)[,2])

school_geo <-
  school_geo %>%
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower)%>% 
  rename(cds = cdscode)

race_ethnicity_groups = c("Black/African American", "All students", "Filipino", "Hispanic", "Multiple Races/Two or more", "White", "American Indian or Alaska Native", "Asian", "Pacific Islander")

student_program_groups = c("All students", "English Learner", "Foster Youth",
                           "Homeless Youth", "Long-Term English Learner", 
                           "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged", "Students with Disabilities")   

```

# Solano County Dashboard Overview

## Dashboard Colors

![CA Dashboard Performance Colors](CDE%20Colors.png){fig-align="center"}

## Counts of Indicator Colors in Solano County Districts

```{r}
#| label: district_table 
#| include: FALSE 

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "D", 
         color != 0, 
         indicator != "science") %>% 
  group_by(districtname) %>% 
  count(color) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = n, values_fill = 0 ) %>% 
  flextable() %>%  
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") %>%
  width(width = c(1.8, 0.8, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 0.8)) %>%
  add_header_row(colwidths = c(1, 5),
                 values = c("","Performance Colors")) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "header", i = 1) %>%
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "body", j = "1") %>%
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "header", j = "1", i = 2) %>%
  bg(bg = "orange", part = "all", j = "2") %>%
  bg(bg = "yellow", part = "all", j = "3") %>%
  bg(bg = "mediumseagreen", part = "all", j = "4") %>%
  bg(bg = "dodgerblue", part = "all", j = "5") %>%
  set_header_labels(districtname = "District", 
                    '1' = "Red (lowest performance)",
                    '2' = "Orange",
                    '3' = "Yellow",
                    '4' = "Green",
                    '5' = "Blue (highest performance)") %>% 
  save_as_image("img/district_table.png")

```

![](img/district_table.png){fig-align="right"}

## Counts of Indicator Colors in Solano County Student Groups: Race/Ethnicity

```{r}
#| label: race_ethnicity_chart
#| echo: FALSE

status_colors <- c(
"tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue"
)

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "D" | (charter_flag == 'Y' & rtype == "S"),
         color != 0,
         indicator != "science",
         student_group_long %in% race_ethnicity_groups) %>%
  mutate(color_word = case_match(color,
                            "1" ~ "Red",
                            "2" ~ "Orange",
                            "3" ~ "Yellow",
                            "4" ~ "Green",
                            "5" ~ "Blue",
                            .default = "")) %>% 
  mutate(color_word = fct_relevel(as_factor(color_word), "Red", "Orange", 
                                            "Yellow", "Green", "Blue")) %>% 
  group_by(student_group_long) %>% 
  count(color_word) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = color_word, y = n, fill = color_word))+
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(y = (n/2)+2.5, label = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~ student_group_long) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Performance Color", y = "Counts of Indicators",
       title = "Count of performance colors assigned to each student race/ethnicity group\nfor all indicators in Solano County LEAs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
  

```

## County Wide ELA Performance (All students)

```{r}
#| label: ela_map
#| echo: FALSE
#| column: screen

academic_districts <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "D",
         student_group_long == "All students",
         indicator == "ELA") %>%
  left_join(district_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname)) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

academic_schools <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "S",
         student_group_long == "All students",
         indicator == "ELA") %>%
  left_join(school_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname, schoolname)) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

leaflet() %>% 
        addTiles() %>% 
        addPolygons(data = academic_districts,
                    fillOpacity = 0.6,
                    color = "#999999",
                    weight = 2,
                    fillColor = ~indicator_color) %>%
        # addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = districts_with_colors(),
        #                     lng = ~lng,
        #                     lat = ~lat,
        #                     label = ~districtname,
        #                 labelOptions = labelOptions(permanent = T)) %>% 
        addCircleMarkers(data = academic_schools,
                         label = ~schoolname,
                         radius = 6,
                         stroke = FALSE,
                         fillOpacity = 1,
                         color = ~indicator_color)


```

```{r}
  left_join(school_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname, schoolname)) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

leaflet() %>% 
        addTiles() %>% 
        addPolygons(data = academic_districts,
                    fillOpacity = 0.6,
                    color = "#999999",
                    weight = 2,
                    fillColor = ~indicator_color) %>%
        addCircleMarkers(data = academic_schools,
                         label = ~schoolname,
                         radius = 6,
                         stroke = FALSE,
                         fillOpacity = 1,
                         color = ~indicator_color)


```

## County Wide Suspension (All students)

```{r}

academic_districts <-

  filter(rtype == "D",
         student_group_long == "All students",
         indicator == "suspension") %>%
  left_join(district_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname)) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

academic_schools <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "S",
         student_group_long == "All students",
         indicator == "suspension") %>%
  left_join(school_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname, schoolname)) %>% 
  st_as_sf()
```

## Academic Performance by Student Group

```{r}
#| label: academic_table_groups
#| echo: FALSE

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "D" | (charter_flag == 'Y' & rtype == "S"),
         color %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
         priority == 4) %>% 
  group_by(student_group_long) %>%
  count(color) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # mutate("5" = 0) %>% # This is only here b/c there are no 5's for academic. Try to remove.
  relocate(student_group_long, '1') %>%
  flextable() %>%  
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") %>%
  width(width = c(1.8, 0.8, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 0.8)) %>%
  add_header_row(colwidths = c(1, 5),
                   values = c("", "Performance Colors")) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "header", i = 1) %>%
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "body", j = "1") %>%
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "header", j = "1", i = 2) %>%
  bg(bg = "orange", part = "all", j = "2") %>%
  bg(bg = "yellow", part = "all", j = "3") %>%
  bg(bg = "mediumseagreen", part = "all", j = "4") %>%
  bg(bg = "dodgerblue", part = "all", j = "5") %>%
  set_header_labels(student_group_long = "Student Group", 
                    '1' = "Red (lowest performance)",
                    '2' = "Orange",
                    '3' = "Yellow",
                    '4' = "Green",
                    '5' = "Blue (highest performance)")
```

## Dashboard Performance for Students Experiencing Homelessness

```{r}
#| label: homeless_chart
#| echo: FALSE
#| tbl-cap: "Counts of Indicator Colors in Solano County Districts "
#| cap-location: bottom

status_colors <- c(
"tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue"
)

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "D" | (charter_flag == 'Y' & rtype == "S"),
         color != 0,
         student_group_long == "Homeless Youth",
         indicator != "college/career") %>% 
  group_by(indicator) %>% 
  count(color) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = color, y = n, fill = color))+
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ indicator) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, guide = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Performance Color", y = "Count of districts",
       title = "Count of Performance Colors assigned to Homeless Youth by Indicator") +
  theme_minimal()

```
